protocol.features: latest available value within previous 6 calendar months, lag in months, calendar-month sine/cosine
protocol.regression: pooled ridge with standardized features, alpha=10, intercept unpenalized
protocol.calibration: 90% absolute residual quantile on disjoint calibration stations; no formal coverage guarantee under dependence or temporal drift
protocol.station_identity: source-specific; telemetry station names may collide, unresolved official station identity
protocol.exclusions: candidate sentinels from prior common-protocol run; official dictionary unavailable

limitations: Common computation does not imply equivalent agency measurements or monitoring schedules
No official missingness schedule, rainfall or GEC-2015 data
Calibration and test stations disjoint, but calibration/test time windows coincide; exchangeability is unverified
Only source-specific evaluation; no state ranking or universal interval guarantee
